files.name: SwimToLand.java

help: Swim by keys straight to seen dry land (surfacing for air) after shore timed out or got stuck
lesson: Shore TIMEOUT repeats up to seven times in a row in the same water, so retrying the same pathfinder route doesn't work; the follow-up should move a different way (direct key swimming) and stop going for a target once it stops getting closer.
summary: swim_to_land: after shore times out or gets stuck, swim to seen land by direct keys (no pathfinder), surfacing for air, to break the repeated shore TIMEOUT loop
